method: Read publisher text; original Polish descriptions; conservative equipment adaptation, no copied prose. Source validates movement, not individualized load or medical suitability.

Sandbag.verified: 7 handles, 3 removable filler bags, maximum recommended 35 kg; user-owned 20 kg is context only, never a prescription. DVRT bag shapes differ: use a lighter fill and secure handles; no throws.

Kółko do brzucha.verified: Double wheel, two side handles, knee mat; no foot straps or assisted return listed. Both hands stay on handles; no feet-on-wheel or single-arm exercises.

contextOnly.verified: 18-minute seated Tai Chi session by Lori Enloe; article supports accessibility context, not a textual movement-by-movement attribution.
